{"overview":"Build a brick-built minifigure-style Jedi (inspired by the reference) with a white tunic, tan belt, blond hair/hood-like head shaping, and a blue lightsaber held in front. Scale: “bigfig/minifig statue” (about 12–15 bricks tall), simple SNOT-free where possible, stable and buildable from common bricks/plates in your inventory.","subassemblies":[{"name":"Display base","description":"A small rectangular pedestal to stabilize the statue; mostly dark bluish gray/black plates and a few white tiles/plates for a clean edge.","image_location":"Bottom of image (under the feet)"} ,{"name":"Feet & lower legs (2x)","description":"Two blocky feet with slightly stepped toes (using plates) and straight shins. White is primary color; add a couple tan/light bluish gray accents if desired to hint at boot/trim like the reference’s leg printing.","image_location":"Bottom left and bottom right (the legs/feet)"} ,{"name":"Hips/pelvis block","description":"A compact core that locks both legs together and supports the torso. Use white bricks with a 1-plate-thick front layer where a belt will attach.","image_location":"Lower center (between legs, just above the thighs)"} ,{"name":"Belt & tunic hem","description":"A horizontal belt band around the waist: tan plates/tiles with small dark red/brown “pouches”/buckle detail at the front (use dark red pieces if tan tiles are limited).","image_location":"Mid-lower center (waist area)"} ,{"name":"Torso/robes","description":"White torso block with a V-neck/robe wrap suggestion: create the V using layered plates/tiles (white with a few dark accents like dark bluish gray or dark tan lines). Keep the chest mostly smooth and bright like the reference.","image_location":"Center of image (chest/upper body)"} ,{"name":"Arms (2x)","description":"Chunky white arms built as simple rectangular columns attached at shoulders. Pose both arms forward to hold the saber; one arm can be slightly higher to mimic the crossed grip.","image_location":"Mid-right and mid-left (arms in front of torso)"} ,{"name":"Hands/grip block","description":"A small, centered grip assembly between the arms using light bluish gray/dark bluish gray rounds/plates to suggest hands around the hilt. Designed to accept a vertical blade element.","image_location":"Center-right (where the hands meet the lightsaber hilt)"} ,{"name":"Lightsaber hilt","description":"Silver/gray cylindrical look: stack light bluish gray/dark bluish gray round elements and short plates to form a 1x1-ish column. Add a small black detail ring if available.","image_location":"Right side of model, held in front of chest"} ,{"name":"Lightsaber blade","description":"Blue blade using trans-clear bars/plates with blue plates/tiles behind (or trans pieces if available). Keep it straight and slightly taller than the head for the iconic silhouette.","image_location":"Upper right diagonal/vertical blade"} ,{"name":"Neck & head core","description":"A small neck spacer (light bluish gray/white) supporting a tan/white head block. Face detail can be implied with minimal dark tiles/plates (eyes/brow) if you want a stylized look.","image_location":"Upper center (head)"}] ,"estimated_total_pieces":120,"notes":["Color-matching the reference: prioritize WHITE for robes/legs/arms; TAN for belt; light/dark bluish gray for saber hilt; BLUE accents for blade.","Keep the arms connected with simple studs-on-top shoulders so you can angle them forward; if joints aren’t available, use stepped plate offsets to approximate the pose.","If you don’t want to build a detailed face, make the head a clean tan/white block and put all character recognition into the blond “hair” shaping and lightsaber.","Use your abundant 2x4/2x3/2x2 bricks (3001/3003/3004/3002) for the internal core, and plates (3020/3021/3022/3023/3024/3710) for shaping and belt layering."]}
